validation_experiments.predicted_result: Some tested feed may fall within the target interval, but no value is promised; purification fractions should permit a measured endpoint assessment.
validation_experiments.falsification: No tested condition meets the target within uncertainty, controls fail, or required residual endpoint cannot be established/met.
validation_experiments.decision_rule: If inputs and assays are qualified and all prespecified criteria pass, retain a candidate for expanded validation. If target misses, revise the bounded feed study. If residual limits or controls remain unresolved, stop at draft and resolve the assay/source gap; never infer purity from appearance or time.
